status: PROPOSED - not locked, nothing built yet
scope_v1: append one function with a one-line body to the host node's script; the body is pass or a single print

block_slots.target: %Name of the host node; its script file is the file that gets the function
block_slots.args: list of 'name: Type' strings, Type in bool/int/float/String/Vector2/Vector3/Color, at most 3, names unique (v1 may be empty)
block_slots.message: ^[A-Za-z0-9 _.,:!?-]{0,40}$ ; must be empty for pass, non-empty for print (no quotes, no backslashes)

harness_builds.canonical_function: <signature>\n<file indent><body line>\n   (body line is  pass  or  print("<message>")  with double quotes)
harness_builds.indent: taken from the script itself (tabs or spaces, first indented line); 4 spaces if it has none
harness_builds.placement: end of the script, one blank line before the function

prefill_anchor.rule: {"frame_id":<frame_id>,"target":<target>,"stmt":"<signature>\n      (the \n is the two characters backslash and n, inside the JSON string)
prefill_anchor.mule_completes: one indented line: pass  or  print('bye')  or  print("bye")
prefill_anchor.ends_on: the escaped newline, never on a space; the mule supplies the indentation

GI_1: ref resolves to a registry host; target matches its name
the host has a script file (a node without a script cannot get a method)
all slots well formed; args names unique; message empty iff body is pass
fn is not a signal or a registered property of the host (Godot accepts func velocity() next to a property velocity)
fn already defined: identical canonical function in the file -> NOOP_ALREADY_DEFINED (no mule); a different body -> REJECT (editing a function is an open slot)
GI_3: stmt is exactly two lines: line 1 equals the signature the harness laid down; line 2 is indented and its trimmed text is pass or print('<message>') or print("<message>")
anything else is refused: a second statement, a comment, return, a different message, no indent
exclude checks from the locked enum
guards.SLOT_4: the harness appends the CANONICAL function to a temporary copy of the whole script (a class_name line is dropped from the copy) and runs godot --headless --check-only on it; exit 0 = ACK
APPLY: append the canonical function; the text is built by the harness from the block, never taken from the mule
headless reload: the host node's script must be instantiable and the node must have the method with the right argument count; otherwise restore the backup
then re-run registry_builder.py so the registry lists the new method (the harness does this, not the mule)

check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.same name as an existing function: exit 1, same name as a previously declared function
check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.function named like a native property (v: exit 0  <- GI_1 has to refuse this one
check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.-> int with a pass body: exit 1, not all code paths return a value (so v1 is void only)
check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.tab indentation in a spaces file: exit 1 (so the harness writes the file's own indent)
check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.a quote inside the print message: exit 1 (so the message charset has no quotes)
check_only_on_a_copy_of_the_whole_script.a second statement after the body: exit 0  <- GI_3 has to refuse this one; Godot cannot

after_writing.good function: fresh Godot: can_instantiate true and the method is in get_script_method_list with its argument count
after_writing.function with a parse error: fresh Godot: can_instantiate false and no methods listed

open_slots: editing or replacing an existing function
adding a function to a script that does not exist yet
placement other than the end of the file
